name: Sonic Wave of Bees
body:
School conjuration (summoning) [sonic]; Level bard 3, druid 3, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, summoner 3, unchained summoner 3, witch 3

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 0 ft.

Effect one swarm of sonic bees
Duration 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You extend your hand and unleash a swarm of sonically infused bees. The bees use the statistics of a wasp swarm but they deal 1d6 additional sonic damage. The swarm begins adjacent to you, but if no living creature is within its area, it moves in one direction of your choosing at normal speed. You can move the swarm or change its direction by spending a standard action to concentrate on the swarm, otherwise it continues moving in its current direction.
